notes.title: THE STEAM AWARDS 🏆 | Grab 55% off in Autumn Sale!
notes.content:
Hello Players! 🕵️

We are pleased to announce that The Shadow Government Simulator is included in this year's Steam Awards and is nominated in the "Labor of Love" category! 🥳 

About this category - This game has been out for a while. The team is well past the debut of their creative baby, but being the good parents they are, these devs continue to nurture and support their creation. This game, to this day, is still getting new content after all these years.

This is a great honor for us and if you think The Shadow Government Simulator deserves this award, you can vote now! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281190/The_Shadow_Government_Simulator/

You can also check out our other games on sale - we prepared some massive discounts on other games! 👇
